info.title: Workout Manager Backend API
info.description: Cloudflare Workers backend for Clerk-authenticated onboarding, backend-owned program generation, workouts, sessions, and progression.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user identity together with onboarding, profile, and active-program state.

401.description: Missing or invalid Clerk Bearer token.

get.description: Returns saved onboarding draft, completion state, and current normalized profile summary.

401.description: Missing or invalid Clerk Bearer token.

post.description: Persists draft onboarding answers without completing onboarding or generating a program.

401.description: Missing or invalid Clerk Bearer token.

post.summary: Complete onboarding and create recommendation draft
post.description: Validates onboarding answers, stores the normalized profile, marks onboarding complete, and creates the current recommendation draft without activating a program yet.

200.description: Onboarding completed and recommendation draft created.

401.description: Missing or invalid Clerk Bearer token.

409.description: Catalog or user state cannot satisfy onboarding completion.

get.description: Returns the generated workout plan for the provided date or for today when no date query parameter is supplied.

schema.description: Optional workout date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.description: Optional workout date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
parameters.name: date

401.description: Missing or invalid Clerk Bearer token.

409.description: Onboarding not completed or no active program exists.

get.description: Returns the active program definition together with current progression metadata and user set counts.

401.description: Missing or invalid Clerk Bearer token.

409.description: Onboarding not completed or no active program exists.

post.description: Creates a new active program version and reseeds progression state from the previous version.

401.description: Missing or invalid Clerk Bearer token.

post.description: Resets the active program to the built-in default program. Requires the X-Reset-Token header.

schema.description: Shared reset token required to reset the active program.

parameters.description: Shared reset token required to reset the active program.
parameters.name: X-Reset-Token

401.description: Missing or invalid Clerk Bearer token.

post.summary: Regenerate active program from onboarding profile
post.description: Uses the stored normalized profile and global exercise catalog to generate a fresh active program version without relying on frontend program composition.

401.description: Missing or invalid Clerk Bearer token.

409.description: Onboarding not completed or no normalized profile exists.

post.summary: Create or refresh recommendation draft from stored profile
post.description: Builds an editable recommendation draft from the stored normalized profile without activating a program.

401.description: Missing or invalid Clerk Bearer token.

409.description: Stored onboarding/profile or catalog state cannot satisfy draft creation.

Missing or invalid Clerk Bearer token.

patch.summary: Replace recommendation draft exercise in a slot

401.description: Missing or invalid Clerk Bearer token.

409.description: Draft is stale, activated, slot is missing, or exercise is not valid for the slot.

200.description: Recommendation draft activated into a normal active program version.

401.description: Missing or invalid Clerk Bearer token.

409.description: Draft is stale or activation state is invalid.

post.description: Evaluates recent session performance and updates progression state for the active program.

409.description: Onboarding not completed or no active program exists.

post.description: Creates a workout session from structured JSON. X-Workout-Date can override the session date.

schema.description: Optional workout date override in YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameters.description: Optional workout date override in YYYY-MM-DD format.
parameters.name: X-Workout-Date
